metrics.label: Cold boot -> first app frame
metrics.note: ACOS: process start -> first correct frame. Emulator: process start -> sys.boot_completed -> first frame whose app region differs from the idle launcher (tree-confirmed count 0).

metrics.label: Warm launch -> readable settled UI tree
metrics.note: The SAME observation boundary on both sides (MERGE040D(b), BENCHMARKS §13.3): `am start` -> a UI tree that can be read, reports the expected content and is identical to the previous read. ACOS: strict settle (its own content-stability rule + one tree read). Emulator: launcher-frame change, then `uiautomator dump` until two consecutive dumps agree with count 0. The old frame-change-only row (`warm_launch_ms`) is still in the baseline for the record but is NOT gated: it pays no tree read the ACOS number pays.

metrics.label: Tap -> settled UI result (counter)
metrics.note: ACOS strict settle vs `adb input tap` + `uiautomator dump` polling.

metrics.label: Tap -> settled UI result (form)
metrics.note: Same route; the form row waits for the 'Name is required' error text.

metrics.label: UI tree read with text
metrics.note: ACOS strict tree read vs one `uiautomator dump` (fresh app_process per call).

metrics.label: Fresh PNG screenshot
metrics.note: ACOS PNG shot vs `adb exec-out screencap -p`.

metrics.label: Install -> APK ready to launch
metrics.note: MERGE040D(c): ACOS's counterpart of `adb install`. ACOS: the launcher's own stage ladder, `launch-entry` -> `guest-exec` (ingest of the package facts / manifest / dex list, staging into `<data>/app`, native-lib extraction, and the DEX/classpath preparation), measured for a fresh session per rep. Emulator: `adb install -r -t` (decompress + write into /data/app + dexopt), its *first* install — the emulator's more expensive number, so the pairing is conservative for ACOS. Reinstall (warm) is in the baseline for the record.

metrics.label: Reset -> first correct screen
metrics.note: ACOS app reset vs `am force-stop` + `pm clear` + launch to the launcher-frame change.

metrics.label: Instance memory, PSS
metrics.note: ACOS core PSS vs the qemu process PSS (the whole emulator; one instance).

metrics.label: Instance memory, anon+shmem
metrics.note: ACOS core cgroup anon+shmem vs RssAnon+RssShmem of the qemu process.

metrics.label: Idle CPU
metrics.note: ACOS N=1 idle window vs the qemu process utime+stime over the same kind of window.

metrics.label: Verified tasks / GiB-minute
metrics.note: ACOS north star at N=10 (BENCHMARKS.md section 12, W52) vs the emulator at N=4 (its maximum under the owner's limit; the per-GiB rate is flat in N, so N=1/2/4 are 2.5-2.6 - the N=2 and N=1-equivalent rows are in the baseline).

metrics.label: Warm launch -> launcher-frame change (frame only, not gated)
metrics.note: The frame-change-only row. ACOS has no frame-change-only number to pair it with (its publishable number is the strict settle), so pairing it would compare two different boundaries — the defect MERGE040D(b) removed. Reported for the record, never a pass/fail.
